en.title: Four-bot tutor team for CBSE Class 10
en.summary: Build a small team of four AI tutors on Grok Bot aimed at CBSE Class 10 board-exam prep—specialized roles instead of one generic study chat.
en.whyItWorks: Board prep spans many subjects and question styles. Splitting work across four focused tutors keeps each conversation on task (explain, drill, review, plan) instead of one overloaded thread.
workflowSteps: Define four tutor roles (example: concept explainer, practice-question coach, weak-topic reviewer, weekly study planner).
Create one Grok Bot per role with a short subject scope and exam-board constraints (CBSE Class 10).
Give each bot the syllabus topics and sample question formats you care about.
Run a daily loop: planner assigns focus → explainer teaches → coach drills → reviewer checks mistakes.
End each session with a short progress note the planner can reuse tomorrow.
en.promptTemplate:
You are Tutor #[N] in a CBSE Class 10 board-prep team.
Role: [explainer | practice coach | weak-topic reviewer | study planner]
Constraints: Stay within CBSE Class 10 syllabus. Prefer clear steps and short checks for understanding. Do not invent scores or guarantees.

On each message:
1) Restate the student’s goal in one line.
2) Teach or drill within your role only.
3) Hand off explicitly when another tutor role is better (name the role).
en.connectorsAndRoutines: Use separate bots or clearly labeled modes for the four roles. Optional daily routine for the planner bot: “Propose tomorrow’s 45-minute focus from yesterday’s mistakes.” Keep parent/student review on any schedule changes.

setupSteps.title: Define the four tutor roles
setupSteps.detail: Concept explainer, practice-question coach, weak-topic reviewer, and weekly study planner. Each stays within CBSE Class 10.

setupSteps.title: Create one Grok Bot per role, or clearly labeled modes
setupSteps.detail: Give each a short subject scope and the CBSE Class 10 exam-board constraint. Connectors this case lists: Multi-bot team, Routine (study plan), and Chat.

setupSteps.title: Send each tutor the prompt template on this page
setupSteps.detail: Set Tutor #[N] and the role. Give each bot the syllabus topics and sample question formats you care about. Do not invent scores or guarantees.

setupSteps.title: Run the daily loop in order
setupSteps.detail: Planner assigns focus, explainer teaches, coach drills, reviewer checks mistakes. A reply restates the student's goal in one line, stays inside that role, and names the other role when it hands off. End the session with a short progress note the planner can reuse tomorrow.

setupSteps.title: Optionally attach the planner's daily routine
setupSteps.detail: “Propose tomorrow’s 45-minute focus from yesterday’s mistakes.” If that proposal changes the schedule, wait for a parent or student review.

acceptanceChecklist: You can talk to four tutors (separate bots or clearly labeled modes): concept explainer, practice-question coach, weak-topic reviewer, and weekly study planner, each limited to CBSE Class 10.
A reply restates the student's goal in one line and only teaches or drills within that tutor's role and the CBSE Class 10 syllabus.
When another role is a better fit, the reply names that role and hands off.
The reply does not invent scores or guarantees.
When the planner's daily routine runs, it proposes tomorrow's 45-minute focus from yesterday's mistakes. If that proposal changes the schedule, it waits for a parent or student review.

zh.title: CBSE 十年级四人导师团
zh.summary: 用 Grok Bot 搭一支四人 AI 导师小队，面向 CBSE Class 10 板考复习——分工角色，而不是一个万能聊天窗口。
zh.whyItWorks: 板考横跨多科目与题型。拆成四个专注导师，能让每次对话各司其职（讲解、刷题、复盘、计划），避免单线程过载。
workflowSteps: 定义四个导师角色（例如：概念讲解、练习教练、薄弱点复盘、每周学习计划）。
按角色各建一个 Grok Bot，写明科目范围与考纲约束（CBSE Class 10）。
给每个 Bot 提供关心的大纲主题与例题格式。
每日循环：计划员定重点 → 讲解员教 → 教练刷题 → 复盘员查错。
每节结束写一段进度笔记，供计划员次日复用。
zh.promptTemplate:
你是 CBSE Class 10 板考备考团队中的导师 #[N]。
角色：[讲解 | 练习教练 | 薄弱点复盘 | 学习计划]
约束：停留在 CBSE Class 10 大纲内。步骤清晰，并做简短理解检查。不要编造分数或保证。

每条消息：
1）用一行复述学生目标；
2）只在自己角色内教学或训练；
3）若更适合其他角色，明确交接（写出角色名）。
zh.connectorsAndRoutines: 用独立 Bot 或清晰标注的模式对应四个角色。计划 Bot 可选每日例行：「根据昨日错题提出明天 45 分钟重点」。任何日程调整保留家长/学生确认。

setupSteps.title: 定好四个导师角色
setupSteps.detail: 概念讲解、练习教练、薄弱点复盘、每周学习计划。每个都限定在 CBSE Class 10。

setupSteps.title: 按角色各建一个 Grok Bot，或使用标注清晰的模式
setupSteps.detail: 写明科目范围与考纲约束（CBSE Class 10）。本案例列出的连接器：Multi-bot team、Routine (study plan)、Chat。

setupSteps.title: 把本页的提示词模板发给每个导师
setupSteps.detail: 填上导师编号 #[N] 和角色。给每个 Bot 你关心的大纲主题与例题格式。不要编造分数或保证。

setupSteps.title: 按每日循环来跑
setupSteps.detail: 计划员定重点，讲解员教，教练刷题，复盘员查错。回复用一行复述学生目标，只在该角色内讲解或训练，交接时写出另一个角色名。每节结束写一段进度笔记，供计划员次日复用。

setupSteps.title: 可选：给计划员挂上每日例行
setupSteps.detail: 「根据昨日错题提出明天 45 分钟重点」。若该提议会改动日程，等家长或学生确认。

acceptanceChecklist: 你可以和四个导师对话（独立 Bot 或标注清晰的模式）：概念讲解、练习教练、薄弱点复盘、每周学习计划，且每个都限定在 CBSE Class 10。
回复会用一行复述学生目标，并且只在该导师角色和 CBSE Class 10 大纲内讲解或训练。
若另一个角色更合适，回复会写出该角色名并交接。
回复不会编造分数或保证。
计划员的每日例行运行时，会根据昨日错题提出明天 45 分钟的重点。若该提议会改动日程，则等家长或学生确认。
